description: Orthopaedic knee case. Exercises all three suppression rule types at once plus the § 5 Abs. 2 factor ladder.

blocked_ziffern.note: Nr. 5 and Nr. 7 exclude each other mutually, so Datalog refuses to decide and the solver arbitrates. Nr. 7 wins on evidence (0.95 vs 0.80), not on money.
A knee puncture matches both the generic Nr. 300 and the knee-specific Nr. 301.
The dressing is a component of the puncture (§ 4 Abs. 2a GOÄ).

factor_expectations.note: Abschnitt O takes the § 5 Abs. 3 band, not the general one
